question: Who is the second Indian chess player to breach the 2800 ELO rating barrier in classical chess as on December 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Arjun Erigaisi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arjun Erigaisi** is the second Indian chess player to breach the 2800 **ELO rating** barrier in classical chess as of December 2024.
 
• The **ELO rating** system is a method for calculating the relative skill levels of players in two-player games such as chess.
 
• He has achieved significant milestones in his chess career at a young age.
 
• Arjun Erigaisi has been recognized for his strategic prowess and consistent performance in various international chess tournaments.
 
• His achievement of crossing the 2800 ELO rating is a testament to his dedication and skill in the game of chess.
